svg.aria-label: A cassette labelled Renewals call plays Side A while four sources slide in beside it: a transcript or notes file you hand it, Google Calendar and Drive finding the meeting's Gemini notes, the slides with the 17, and the message I think that went badly. It rewinds and prints the debrief like a receipt, including seventy spoken versus 17 on the slide and So which one first asked at 00:09:30 with the options only at 00:24:00. Flipped to Side B, the deck build session is read from the Claude Code session log (Codex and Cursor marked untested; it reads only counts and times); a counter runs from 10:00 to 13:52 past 12 edits before the 14:00 call, three rules for Claude are written on the insert, each with its log time, and they are saved to the shelf only after the yes box is ticked.

g.text: saved, only because you said yes
8 for the AI: flip to B
